column2: (2) Every Assistant Commissioner to whom any power or
function  has  been  delegated  under  subsection  (1)  shall
exercise or discharge such power or function subject to the
general or special directions of the Commissioner-General.
36. Any registered person who has paid any levy or penalty
in excess of any amount which he was liable to pay for any
relevant quarter shall be treated as an advance payment made
for any quarter succeeding the relevant quarter.
